stories.title: Continúa Fase 1 de Contingencia Ambiental por Ozono en la ZMVM; se mantiene el doble Hoy no Circula

en.title: Phase 1 of Environmental Contingency for Ozone Continues in ZMVM; Double Hoy no Circula Remains in Effect
en.summary: Phase 1 of an environmental contingency related to ozone levels continues in Mexico City's metropolitan area with the double vehicle restriction program still active.

stories.title: Cruz Azul vs América EN VIVO sigue aquí el MINUTO A MINUTO del Clásico Joven de Liga MX

en.title: Cruz Azul vs América LIVE Follow the MINUTE BY MINUTE of the Young Classic of Liga MX
en.summary: Cruz Azul and América face off in Matchday 8 of the Apertura 2028 season in a Liga MX match.

stories.title: Se activa la Contingencia Ambiental y el Doble Hoy No Circula en la CDMX y el Valle de México

en.title: Environmental Contingency and Double Hoy No Circula Activated in Mexico City and the Valley of Mexico
en.summary: Environmental authorities activated a contingency alert and vehicle restriction program in Mexico City and its surrounding valley, recommending measures to reduce public exposure to polluted air.

stories.title: Aniversario del golpe de Pinochet deja 284 detenidos y 198 hechos de violencia en Chile

en.title: Anniversary of Pinochet's Coup Results in 284 Arrests and 198 Violence Incidents in Chile
en.summary: Thousands gathered in Chile to commemorate victims of the dictatorship on the coup anniversary, with police recording numerous arrests and violent incidents while the government did not hold an official ceremony.

stories.title: Real Madrid golea al Rayo Vallecano con doblete de Mbappé

en.title: Real Madrid thrashes Rayo Vallecano with Mbappé brace
en.summary: Real Madrid defeated Rayo Vallecano at the Santiago Bernabéu with French forward Mbappé scoring twice in a dominant performance.

stories.title: Metro cierra estación Zócalo/Tenochtitlan de Línea 2; lluvia provoca marcha lenta en cuatro líneas

en.title: Metro closes Zócalo/Tenochtitlan station on Line 2; rain causes delays on four lines
en.summary: Mexico City's metro system closed a central station and experienced slowdowns on multiple lines due to rainfall, with authorities directing passengers to alternative stations.

stories.title: Hay 5 predios afectados por explosión en Álvaro Obregón: Clara Brugada; anuncia apoyos económicos

en.title: Five properties affected by explosion in Álvaro Obregón: Clara Brugada announces economic aid
en.summary: Mexico City's mayor Clara Brugada reported that five properties were damaged in an explosion that occurred on Friday, September 11, and announced financial support for affected residents.

stories.title: Mbappé firma doblete en goleada del Real Madrid y alcanza al Barcelona en LaLiga

en.title: Mbappé scores brace in Real Madrid rout and ties Barcelona in LaLiga
en.summary: Mbappé scored twice and provided an assist as Real Madrid defeated their opponent 4-1, bringing the team to 12 points and level with Barcelona in the league standings.

stories.title: Activan contingencia Fase I en ZMVM

en.title: Contingency Phase I Activated in Mexico City Metropolitan Area
en.summary: Environmental authorities activated Phase I contingency measures for ozone in Mexico City. Vehicles with license plates ending in 7 or 8, as well as 0 and 00 vehicles with pink stickers, are prohibited from circulating on Sunday.

stories.title: Explosión en Álvaro Obregón: sube a dos el número de muertos; Fiscalía investiga las causas

en.title: Explosion in Álvaro Obregón: death toll rises to two; Prosecutor's Office investigates causes
en.summary: An explosion at a food stand in Mexico City resulted in two deaths and 14 injuries, with specialized experts investigating the incident's cause.

stories.title: América estrena refuerzos ante Cruz Azul: ¿a qué hora y dónde ver el Clásico Joven?

en.title: América debuts reinforcements against Cruz Azul: what time and where to watch the Clásico Joven?
en.summary: América enters Matchday 8 as undefeated leaders, while Cruz Azul attempts to stop them and improve their standings in the Apertura 2026 tournament.

stories.title: Cruz Azul será local, pero el Azteca es la casa del América: Zendejas

en.title: Cruz Azul will be home team, but the Azteca is América's house: Zendejas
en.summary: América player Alejandro Zendejas conveyed that despite Cruz Azul being the designated home team for Saturday's match, the Azteca Stadium belongs to the Eagles. Cruz Azul remains the only Liga MX club without its own stadium despite being owned by a cement company.

stories.title: ¿Abren los bancos el 15 y 16 de septiembre? No todos operan igual

en.title: Do Banks Open on September 15 and 16? Not All Operate the Same
en.summary: Banks will provide limited services on September 15 and 16 during the national holidays. Customer service options through ATMs and branches will vary by institution.

stories.title: Trump no contempla salir del T-MEC y promete una excelente relación con México, pero golpea a Canadá

en.title: Trump Does Not Contemplate Leaving USMCA and Promises Excellent Relations with Mexico, but Targets Canada
en.summary: Trump indicated he does not plan to withdraw from USMCA and stated he will maintain positive relations with Mexico. Simultaneously, he raised new complaints against Canada during the trade agreement review.

stories.title: Este seguro escolar gratuito cubre hasta 40,000 pesos a estudiantes, ¿cómo funciona y quién puede usarlo?

en.title: This Free School Insurance Covers Up to 40,000 Pesos for Students—How Does It Work and Who Can Use It?
en.summary: A free insurance program provides coverage of up to 40,000 pesos to students for school-related accidents. Protection is subject to specific conditions and does not cover all circumstances.

stories.title: La CLABE no desaparece, pero el Banco de México cambiará la forma de realizar transferencias

en.title: CLABE will not disappear, but Mexico's Central Bank will change the way transfers are made
en.summary: Mexico's Central Bank will modify the bank transfer process without eliminating the CLABE system. Financial institutions have until December 2026 to adapt their systems to the changes, which include standardizing the mobile app experience for transfers.

stories.title: Porsche deja ir a Bugatti y destina parte de la venta a pagar pensiones

en.title: Porsche divests from Bugatti and allocates sale proceeds toward pension payments
en.summary: Porsche sold Bugatti as part of a strategic shift aimed at improving profitability and cash flow in a more demanding market, with some proceeds directed to pension obligations.
